login.subtitle: Welcome back!
login.childSignInNotice: Children cannot sign in from another device yet. A parent can open their profile on an already signed-in device.

register.intro: Create your Penderie space and add your family members in a few clicks
register.birthDateHint: This date is self-declared, not an official verification. Adult registration is for people aged 18 or over; minors must use a profile created by a parent.
register.termsLead: By creating the account you accept the

verify.sentLead: A confirmation e-mail has been sent to:
verify.sentInstruction: Click the link we sent you to activate your account.
verify.tokenNotice: Confirm this address to create your account. Your password is never sent by e-mail.
verify.noTokenLead: This link contains no confirmation token. Enter your address to request a new link.
verify.expiredError: This link is invalid or has expired. You can request a new one below.
verify.genericError: We could not confirm your address right now. Try again.
verify.resendSuccess: If a pending registration exists for this address, a new link will be sent. Wait at least one minute between requests.
verify.resendFailure: We could not process your request right now. Try again later.

account.title: My account
account.usernameDescription: Your existing account does not have a username yet. Choose one so friends can find you. You will not be able to change it later.
account.usernameTaken: That username is already in use. Choose another one.
account.usernameError: Could not save the username. Please try again.
account.languageDescription: Choose the language of the app. Your choice is saved on this device.

friends.title: Friends
friends.addDescription: Enter their username (shown in My account, not their email). Follow them directly or send a friend request: the request follows them immediately, and you become friends if they accept. Their email must be verified.
friends.followed: You are now following this account.
friends.noFollowing: You are not following anyone yet.
friends.noFriends: Friends will appear here after they accept.
friends.adultOnly: Friend requests are for adult accounts only.

profiles.pinNote: This PIN protects profile switching on this device. It cannot be used to sign in on another device.

errors.notFound: No verified account was found with that username. Check the spelling and ask your friend to verify their email address.
errors.conflict: This request or relationship already exists, or is no longer available.
errors.forbidden: This action is for verified adult accounts only.
errors.rateLimited: Too many actions in a short time. Wait a little before trying again.
